LanguageData.DMS_LabFurnace.label: Lab Furnace
LanguageData.DMS_LabFurnace.description: A box-type induction furnace for small-scale trial production of materials. Compared with full-scale production equipment it uses very little power and floor space, making it ideal for factions that do not yet need large amounts of special materials.
LanguageData.DMS_LabReactor.label: Lab reactor
LanguageData.DMS_LabReactor.description: A laboratory-scale reaction chamber for small-scale trial production of materials. Compared with full-scale production equipment it uses very little power and floor space, making it ideal for factions that do not yet need large amounts of special materials.
LanguageData.DMS_TableArtifuscle.label: Artifuscle Chamber
LanguageData.DMS_TableArtifuscle.description: High-end production equipment for cultivating Artifuscle and bionics.
LanguageData.DMS_TableStampManual.label: Manual stamping press
LanguageData.DMS_TableStampManual.description: A stripped-down stamping press with the feed line and control rack removed. Every stroke has to be set up and fed by hand, but it takes up far less floor space and draws a fraction of the power of a full machinery printer.
